newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Jilin Chemical plans second big debt offer.
newsitem.headline: China's Jilin Chemical plans second big debt offer.

text.p: China's Jilin Chemical Group, currently offering one billion yuan ($120 million) of bonds to the public, plans a second one billion yuan debt offer this year, officials said on Monday.
"We will issue a second batch of one billion yuan of bonds this year," a company official said by telephone from company headquarters in Jilin city in northeastern Jilin province.
Jilin Chemical Group is the biggest shareholder of Jilin Chemical Industrial Co Ltd, which has shares listed in Shenzhen and in Hong Kong.

Jilin Chemical Group is currently offering one billion yuan of three-year bonds, which pay annual interest of 11 percent. The offer closes on March 21. The second batch has not yet been approved by the State Planning Commission, the official said.
A State Planning Commission official said the second offer would also be three-year debt carrying interest of 11 percent. Timing and other details of the offer had not yet been fixed.

Funds raised would be used to finance Jilin Chemical's share of a 300,000-tonne per year ethylene project, the group official said. Total investment in the project is expected to reach 10 billion yuan.
